body: Champion hinted budget could grow to 45000 and that they might sign by 2026-03-31. Nothing is confirmed yet.
Technical evaluation passed. Their security team starts its review next week, so this deal is now in Security Review. Procurement confirmed a target signature date of 2026-05-29.
Budget was re-approved after the freeze at 180000. Procurement now targets signature on 2026-06-30. The stage stays Discovery until the new evaluation starts.
Before leaving, our champion said the security review now sits with their Head of Infrastructure, who should own this deal going forward.
Standard check-in; no material change to plan.
